messages:
Asha (FinOps): Noticed ~47 invoices in today's reconciliation with lines_count=1 but invoice_total > 0. Looks like usage lines didn't attach before finalize. Posting here to avoid premature credits.

Marco (Payments Eng): Any pattern in logs? Could be webhook ordering or a consumer restart.

Asha (FinOps): Times cluster around 2026-03-29T09:40-09:50 UTC. Example invoice inv_03Kt2M4Q for cus_P2x... Log snippet: 
```
2026-03-29T09:41:12Z INFO webhook-consumer got evt=invoice.finalized id=inv_03Kt2M4Q seq=1207
2026-03-29T09:41:10Z INFO webhook-consumer got evt=usage.reported id=evt_u_99 seq=1205
2026-03-29T09:41:13Z ERROR invoice-apply missing lines inv_03Kt2M4Q
```
Sequence 1205 -> 1207, usages delayed.

ops-bot: Alert: webhook.reorder_detected count=12 window=2026-03-29T09:40:00Z-2026-03-29T09:50:00Z. DLQ entries=5. Ticket INC-2026-3459 created.

Lydia (Billing Ops): I'll pause NetSuite push for 09:30-10:00 UTC. Please don't create manual refunds.

Marco (Payments Eng): I'll push a small fix to make consumer apply events ordered by stripe_event.created and to enqueue out-of-order events to DLQ instead of applying finalize immediately. PR payments/consumer#477. Deploy ETA 2h after tests.

Asha (FinOps): Can we run a dry-run replay of DLQ and compare invoice checksums before applying? Want to avoid any posted invoice changes if NetSuite already saw them.

Marco (Payments Eng): Replay CLI: 
```bash
./tools/replay_dlq --since 2026-03-29T09:35:00Z --to 2026-03-29T09:55:00Z --dry-run --checksum-compare --skip-posted=true
```
Will post dry-run results and list of invoices that would be modified.

Lydia (Billing Ops): Exporting affected invoice IDs to gs://redwood-finance/backfills/2026-03-29-missing-usages.csv and notifying AR to hold posting.

Asha (FinOps): Thanks. Let's add an alert for webhook.sequence_gap and a grafana panel for "invoices with fewer-than-usage-lines". Marco please own postmortem.

Marco (Payments Eng): Will do. Updating INC-2026-3459 and will coordinate the replay once patch is live.
